question: How can I track my order status?
alternate_questions: How do I check the delivery status of my order?
Can I track my shipment online?
answer: You can track your order by going to the 'My Orders' section in your account dashboard and clicking on 'Track Package'. We also send an email and SMS with a live carrier tracking link as soon as your parcel ships.

question: Can I cancel or modify my order after placing it?
alternate_questions: How do I cancel my order?
Can I change the items in my order?
Is it possible to edit my purchase before shipping?
answer: Orders can be canceled or edited within 1 hour of placement directly from your Order History page. After 1 hour, processing begins in the warehouse and changes cannot be made, but you can initiate a free return once received.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
alternate_questions: How do I update my shipping address?
I entered the wrong address for my order
answer: You can change your shipping address within 45 minutes of order confirmation in your account. If the order has already been dispatched, please contact our support team immediately so we can request a redirection with the courier.

question: What are your shipping options and delivery times?
alternate_questions: Do you have express or next-day shipping?
answer: We offer Standard Shipping (3-5 business days), Express Shipping (1-2 business days), and Same-Day Delivery in select metropolitan areas for orders placed before 12:00 PM.

question: How much does shipping cost?
alternate_questions: Is shipping free on all items?
answer: Standard delivery is completely free for all orders over $49. For orders under $49, a flat shipping fee of $4.99 applies. Express shipping is available for $9.99 regardless of order value.

question: Do you ship internationally outside the country?
alternate_questions: Can I place an international order?
Which countries do you deliver to?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide via DHL Express. International delivery takes typically 5 to 10 business days. Import duties, customs, and taxes are calculated and displayed at checkout.

question: What is your return policy?
alternate_questions: How long do I have to return an item?
Can I return an opened or used product?
What are the rules for returning products?
answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return window on most products from the date of delivery. Items must be in their original packaging with all included accessories, manuals, and proof of purchase.

question: How do I initiate a return or replacement?
alternate_questions: How can I return a product?
Steps to send back an item
How to get a replacement for a broken item?
answer: To start a return, visit our Returns Portal (novatech.com/returns), enter your Order Number and email, select the items you wish to return, and print your prepaid return shipping label.

question: How long does it take to receive a refund?
alternate_questions: When will I get my money back?
What is the refund processing time?
How many days for refund to reflect in my bank?
answer: Once our warehouse receives and inspects your returned item (usually within 2 business days of arrival), refunds are processed to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.

question: What should I do if my item arrives damaged or defective?
alternate_questions: The package was damaged during transit
Product is not working out of the box
answer: We sincerely apologize! If your package arrived damaged or the product is defective, report it within 48 hours of delivery via our Support Chat or email support@novatech.com with photos of the damaged packaging and item. We will ship a brand-new replacement immediately at zero cost.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
alternate_questions: Can I pay with credit card or PayPal?
Do you take Apple Pay or Google Pay?
answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay. We also offer flexible installments via Klarna and Afterpay.

question: Do you offer installments, financing, or Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL)?
alternate_questions: Can I pay in monthly installments?
Do you support EMI or split payments?
How does Klarna or Afterpay work?
answer: Yes! We partner with Klarna and Affirm to offer 0% APR financing on orders over $150. You can split your purchase into 4 equal bi-weekly interest-free payments or choose monthly payment plans up to 12 months.

question: Is my payment information safe and secure?
alternate_questions: Do you save my credit card details?
How secure is the checkout process?
Is it safe to buy from your website?
answer: Yes, absolutely. Our checkout is protected by 256-bit SSL encryption and Level 1 PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways. We never store your full card number or CVV on our servers.

question: What is covered under the product warranty?
alternate_questions: How long is the manufacturer warranty?
answer: All hardware products sold by NovaTech come with a 1-year standard manufacturer warranty covering manufacturing defects, internal component failures, and hardware malfunctions. Accidental damage, water damage, or unauthorized modifications are excluded unless you purchased NovaTech Care+ Protection.

question: How do I claim a warranty repair or replacement?
alternate_questions: How to file a warranty claim?
Process to get a warranty replacement
answer: To claim your warranty, visit novatech.com/warranty, enter your device's serial number and invoice number, describe the malfunction, and attach any diagnostic video/photo. Our engineering team reviews claims within 24 hours.

question: Do I need an account to place an order?
alternate_questions: Can I checkout as a guest?
Is an account required to buy?
Do I have to register to make a purchase?
answer: No, an account is not required. You can always check out as a guest. However, creating a free account allows you to track shipments easily, save multiple addresses, earn loyalty reward points, and manage returns seamlessly.

question: How do I reset my account password?
alternate_questions: How to change my login credentials?
answer: Click on the 'Sign In' icon at top right, select 'Forgot Password?', and enter your registered email address. We will send you a secure password reset link valid for 30 minutes.

question: How can I delete my account or personal data?
answer: Under GDPR and CCPA regulations, you have full ownership of your data. To delete your account and personal history, navigate to Account Settings > Privacy & Data > Delete Account, or submit a request to privacy@novatech.com.

question: How do I apply a promo code or discount coupon?
alternate_questions: Where do I enter a promo code?
My coupon code is not working
answer: During checkout on the payment review step, look for the 'Promo / Gift Card' box on the right summary panel. Enter your code and click 'Apply'. Note that only one promo code can be applied per order.

question: Do you offer student, military, or educator discounts?
alternate_questions: Is there a discount for students?
answer: Yes! We offer a 10% discount for verified students, educators, first responders, and military personnel via Student Beans and ID.me. Visit novatech.com/community-discounts to verify your status instantly.

question: Do you offer a price match guarantee?
alternate_questions: Will you match a lower price from another retailer?
What is your price match policy?
answer: Yes! If you find an identical item sold and shipped by authorized retailers (e.g. Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart) for a lower price within 14 days of purchase, contact us and we will gladly refund the price difference.

question: How can I contact customer support?
alternate_questions: What is your customer service phone number?
How do I speak with a human agent?
What are your support operating hours?
answer: Our customer support team is available 24/7. You can reach us via Live Chat on our website, email at support@novatech.com, or toll-free by phone at 1-800-555-NOVA (Monday through Friday, 8 AM - 8 PM EST).

question: Do you have physical retail stores I can visit?
alternate_questions: Can I buy or pick up in store?
answer: Yes, we have 18 flagship stores across major cities including New York, San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, and Seattle. You can check opening hours and inventory or reserve items for in-store pickup at novatech.com/stores.

question: Can I purchase and use electronic gift cards?
alternate_questions: How do I redeem an electronic gift certificate?
answer: Yes, NovaTech e-Gift Cards are available in values from $25 to $500 and are delivered instantly via email. NovaTech gift cards never expire and have no maintenance fees.
